# Al Meknassi Bijoux (almeknassi.com)

> Luxury jewelry in Morocco — elegant gold-shine sets with cash on delivery nationwide.

## Brand

- Name: Al Meknassi Bijoux (Al Meknassi Jewelry / المكناسي)
- Site: https://almeknassi.com/
- Languages: French (main), English, Arabic (RTL)
- Payment: cash on delivery — check the parcel before paying, pay only if satisfied
- Delivery: all over Morocco, free delivery on the featured set
- Ordering: via the order form on the site, confirmed over WhatsApp

## Featured product

- Coffret RADKO Doré / RADKO Gold Set / طقم الرادكو الذهبي
- Price: 279 MAD (was 450 MAD)
- Includes: necklace + bracelet + ring + earrings + luxury gift box
- Materials: hypoallergenic stainless steel, water resistant, 2-year warranty
- Page: https://almeknassi.com/product/1
